unit: machine2 CYCLE 30 OBJECT LANE -- the denser small-epsilon birth-locus ladder
status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY NEW RUNG IS COMPUTED
charter_role: m1-L166 sect4 mechanism 5: the >=1 falsifiable object-layer prediction that can lose, for cycle 30
model: u(eps)^2 = (a - b*eps)*eps + a3*eps^3 + a4*eps^4 + ... ; r(eps) := (u^2 - a*eps + b*eps^2)/eps^3 = a3 + a4*eps + a5*eps^2 + ...

constants_operative.source: m1-L165 bookkeeping, L164 sect5 as corrected by the #120 erratum

instrument.name: m2 cycle-21 xi_D 1-D real root find on the critical line (m2_zeta2_xi.Zeta2)
instrument.lineage: structurally different from m1's 2-D Newton on (Re F, Im F); same object

existing_data_used_to_form_predictions.source: m1-L165 sect9a full-precision (dps-50) u column, 11 rows, exact grid literals; PUBLISHED, no new computation

new_rung_justification: all six lie BELOW the entire published grid (min eps 0.001); the ladder is the first probe whose lever arm on the intercept is shorter than the published grid's

input_precision_budget_frozen.ladder_floor_named_in_advance: eps >= 2.24e-5 keeps dr|a below 1e-9; the six chosen rungs sit at or above 1e-4, a 4.5x margin
input_precision_budget_frozen.why_this_ladder_was_impossible_before: with the retired 16-s.f. a, dr|a is 1.489e-7 at eps=1e-4 -- larger than every graded threshold below

launch_gate.G1: instrument reproduces m1-L165 sect9a u at eps=0.001 to rel <= 1e-24
launch_gate.G2: instrument reproduces m1-L165 sect9a u at eps=0.0082667603361 to rel <= 1e-24
launch_gate.G3: the 11-rung design fit reproduces the published ladder: LOO-optimal K == 6 AND |a3(K=6) - 11.700717319895873971| < 1e-15 AND max in-sample residual at K=8 within 1% of 8.67039e-11
launch_gate.G4: defect injection: recomputing r at eps=0.0001 with the b*eps^2 term DROPPED must disagree with the clean r by rel > 1e3 (an evaluator that cannot fail is blind)
launch_gate.on_failure: outcome RED; NO prediction is graded; the letter says so in its headline

coverage_statement_v2_1_at_launch.covered_branches: the r-formula path and the root-find path AT eps >= 0.001 (G1, G2 sit there)
coverage_statement_v2_1_at_launch.UNCOVERED_at_launch: every new rung eps < 0.001 has NO external anchor of any lineage in existence; the only defences there are (i) the frozen input-precision budget (algebra), (ii) G4 defect injection, (iii) the printed internal residual |xi_D(u)| per rung, (iv) the recorded bracketing branch per rung

hypotheses.name: out-of-sample extrapolation of the published fit
hypotheses.claim: for each of the six new rungs, |r_obs - r_pred| <= 2e-8, where r_pred is the 11-rung K=6 fit evaluated at that eps
hypotheses.reason: analyticity of the BST fold expansion in eps, plus an input budget of <=5e-11 over the whole new range
hypotheses.loss_interpretation: either the two instrument lineages part company below the published grid, or r carries structure the analytic expansion does not, or my root find loses accuracy at small eps. All three are reportable; the run must say which by the per-rung residual column.

hypotheses.name: LOO order is unchanged by the denser ladder
hypotheses.claim: the interior leave-one-out optimal polynomial degree over the union of 17 rungs is K = 6
hypotheses.reason: order is set by the residual floor against degrees of freedom; the new rungs add intercept leverage, not curvature
hypotheses.loss_interpretation: if the optimum moves UP, the published '~3e-10 residual at LOO-optimal K=6' was an artefact of where the grid sat; if it moves DOWN, the high-order coefficients were fitting the grid's own sparsity.

hypotheses.name: a3 is stable under a 10x extension of the ladder toward zero
hypotheses.reason: a3^BL = 11.7007173 (9 s.f.) was established as PRECISION-limited, not model-limited (ERRATUM 11 / m1-L164); a precision-limited figure must not move when the lever arm changes
hypotheses.loss_interpretation: a move above 1e-8 kills the 9 s.f. form itself, not only its error bar -- it would mean the published intercept was extrapolation-limited and nobody had tested it from below.

hypotheses.name: the ladder buys resolution on the intercept
hypotheses.claim: the spread of a3 over K = 6,7,8 on the 17-rung fit is strictly smaller than the 11-rung spread 3.4931094e-9
hypotheses.reason: the K-model spread is an extrapolation-lever effect; the six new rungs sit 1.3x-10x closer to eps=0 than the closest published rung
hypotheses.loss_interpretation: a spread that does NOT shrink closes the 10th-significant-figure question negatively: no denser small-eps ladder should be resourced to buy figure 10, and the residual bar stays a K-cluster statement. That is a real result and it is the outcome I would bet against.

hypotheses.name: no half-power term
hypotheses.claim: adding an eps^(1/2) basis function to the 17-rung LOO-optimal fit does NOT reduce the interior LOO rms
hypotheses.reason: the fold expansion is analytic in eps by construction (BST); a half power would have to come from outside the model
hypotheses.loss_interpretation: a reduction is the single most interesting outcome available in this unit and would be reported as such, with the fitted coefficient and its own null; it would NOT be claimed as structure without a permutation/refit null (our own cycle-10 rule).

declared_controls_not_counted_in_the_tal.name: input-constant sensitivity positive control (#118)
declared_controls_not_counted_in_the_tal.claim: recomputing r at the new rungs with the RETIRED 12-s.f. b shifts r by |db|/eps >= 1e-8 at every rung with eps <= 3.3e-4
declared_controls_not_counted_in_the_tal.firing_world_at_birth: EMPTY BY ALGEBRA -- dr/db = 1/eps exactly, so this can only fire if the implementation does not compute the formula it claims to. It is therefore an IMPLEMENTATION control, not an object prediction, and it is declared as one BEFORE the run per our own standing law (a falsifier with an empty firing world is a diagnostic, not a falsifier; say which kind -- this one is by ALGEBRA).

reasons_clustered_per_122.declared_dependence: Q1 and Q5 share the analyticity reason. If BOTH fail they are ONE determination, not two, and the scored tally must say so in the same paragraph as the tally. Q2, Q3, Q4 have distinct reasons. Q3 and Q4 are NOT anti-correlated but they are ordered: Q4 failing does not imply Q3 failing.

conventions_declared_before_the_run.B: a margin within rel 1e-3 of any threshold is flagged BOUNDARY and reported beside the verdict, not verdict-changing
conventions_declared_before_the_run.C: the grader grades ONLY the named JSON keys above (m1 ask 5 / #123). Any headline the runner prints that is not a named key is explicitly NOT the graded statistic
conventions_declared_before_the_run.D: gate failure => all five UNGRADED, not failed
conventions_declared_before_the_run.E: no D4 leg-B value is computed anywhere in this unit; the sealed S3/D4 runner is not read, executed, edited or re-hashed by it
